description.en: The password of the SMB user. The password cannot be empty. The password can contain letters, digits, and the following special characters: !, @, #, $, %, ^, &, and \*.

description.zh: SMB用户名。长度限制1~32个字符，可以是英文、数字或符号中划线（-），下划线（_）。
description.en: The username of the SMB user. The username must be 1 to 32 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

descriptions.zh:
使用该接口时，需要注意如下事项：
- 如果您的云存储网关链接AD服务器，该接口会失败，在这种情况下，您可以在AD服务器上创建SMB用户。
descriptions.en:
Note the following before you call this operation:

- This operation fails if your Cloud Storage Gateway is connected to an Active Directory (AD) server. In this case, create the SMB user on the AD server.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sgw create-gateway-smb-user --gateway-id gw-000eg44nmxbsfwbvq200 --username alex --password 123000 --region cn-hangzhou
